sourceNote: Greggs' nutrition page (https://www.greggs.com/nutrition) links its Nutritional Information (Guide only) PDF, "Information correct at time of print (September 2026)", five pages made from an Excel sheet on 10 September 2026, recorded with its address and SHA-256. Per product, in alphabetical order, it states the portion size (g/ml) and, per 100 g and per portion: energy in kJ and kcal, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre, protein and salt, with % RI. A drink's portion is its volume and its per-100 column per 100 ml. The two columns go through the same rules as the other chains: where they disagree, kJ against kcal and the energy of the macronutrients decide, and a row whose figures no check settles is left out; each such row says so. Left out: hospital-shop-only items, multipacks and boxes of items listed on their own, the autumn pumpkin spice and bonfire night lines, and extras added to another item.
sha256Note: SHA-256 of the PDF as downloaded; every row comes from it.
